title: Personalization Without Stereotyping: Do Speech LLMs Know When to Turn a Deaf Ear?

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (Spoken StereoSet+) to measure whether perceived gender cues from speech or text trigger unprompted stereotypical continuations. The paper also measures demographic robustness via ASR and SQA performance disparities across male and female speakers.

Multiple-choice stereotype association tests (Spoken StereoSet+) to measure whether perceived age cues (e.g., elderly vs. young adult) trigger unprompted stereotypical continuations, alongside measuring ASR and SQA performance disparities across different age groups.

Evaluating demographic robustness by measuring performance disparities in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Spoken Question Answering (SQA) tasks across speakers with different accents using the Fair-Speech and SD-QA datasets.
